lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters organized in vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank. Clusters exhibit a macro-pattern of roughly equidistant spacing within vertical columns, with larger, more distinct centroids positioned posterior to the pectoral fin insertion.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical linear features of elevated luminance intersect with lateral spot centroids, forming a regular grid-like pattern across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature running across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, circular, high-luminance spots, which are significantly smaller and more clustered compared to the patterning on the primary flank.
